subject.title: NASPO Catalog Project (Completed) & MMIS AI Project (Learning Phase)
details: NASPO Catalog Project (https://github.com/RossJiao/naspo-catalog-project): Downloaded 4 NASPO Excel files from Vesta server (new server: 107.181.252.194). Imported 1,015,548 records into SQLite database using Python and pandas. Built Django web interface for searching the NASPO procurement catalog. Search supports: product description, vendor name, manufacturer part number. Deployed locally and tested with sample queries (Q247, license). Pushed code to GitHub (excluding large database file). Created dbdiagram.io ERD and presentation slides.

MMIS AI - Electronic Claim Entry & Submission Portal (Learning Phase): Assigned to Group 2: Creating ANSI X12 837P from database records. Team lead: Le Luo. Watched EDI X12 and 837P tutorial videos. Had 1-on-1 meeting with Amanda to align on project expectations. Reviewed CMS-1500 to 837P mapping document. Understanding of X12 837P structure: ISA/GS envelope, Loop 2000 (patient), Loop 2300 (claim), Loop 2400 (service lines).

notes: NASPO Catalog: 1M+ products indexed and searchable.
X12 837P is the electronic version of the CMS-1500 paper form.
ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS codes are used in the claim.
MMIS project is still in learning phase — no code written yet.
